title: Expected CLI errors
responsibility: Provides the error class used for deliberate CLI failures and the functions to throw or recognize it.

inputs.name: fail.message
inputs.description: Human-readable failure message to attach to the expected CLI error.

inputs.name: isExpectedCliError.error
inputs.description: Any value to test for membership in the ExpectedCliError class.

outputs.name: fail
outputs.description: Never returns: immediately throws a new ExpectedCliError containing the supplied message.

outputs.name: isExpectedCliError
outputs.description: True only when the value is an instance of ExpectedCliError, narrowing its TypeScript type.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The Error subclass thrown by fail, with its name set to ExpectedCliError.
